summary: Blue shakes a B handshape in front of you with a small twist of the wrist.
steps: Make a B (flat hand, thumb tucked).
Shake it with a small side-to-side twist.
Keep the B crisp so it doesn't blur into GREEN or YELLOW.
note: Blue, green, yellow, and purple are all the first letter shaken. The handshape is the whole difference, so keep each one clean.
mistakes: A loose hand. B, G, Y, and P look alike at speed if the fingers aren't exact.
